deep_analysis:
Open book: 3 trades, all LONG, ~+0.15 USDT, against an aggregate 5m SHORT_BIAS tape (66 short / 6 long / 52 neutral), btc_15m SHORT_BIAS, btc_4h SHORT_BIAS, trend_quality STRONG_DOWN. Everything long is alive on one condition: BTC's 1m reclaimed EMA300 (last cross 18:11 UTC, 431 min above) and price was 80352 vs EMA300 80295 at 21:46 — but the gap compressed from +96 pts (21:41) to +25 pts in five minutes, while continuum linreg stays LEAN_BEAR. Sources disagree and must be cited: 5m aggregate = SHORT_BIAS (flipped LONG->SHORT at 21:30 after five LONG_BIAS dumps 20:15-21:15), regimes.BTC = NEUTRAL (held NEUTRAL across all last six dumps), continuum = AT EMA300 / LEAN_BEAR. Flip rates: aggregate 17/24h, BTC 15m 16/24h — both inside the p25-p50 band (p50=19), i.e. the standing high-churn state, not an anomaly and not a trend tape (<6 has not occurred since Oct 2). An average direction state survives ~1.5h, so every direction call below is condition-keyed, not asserted.

Trade by trade. BTC #16385 LONG (continuum+, meta_rsi 5.5, +0.09%, 0.5h) — the only structurally defensible long: LONG meta_rsi<35 is 4T/3W/+0.17, the single positive long bucket this week, and the continuum family runs 86% WR. Hold condition re-tested at 21:46: 1m still closing above EMA300 (12 straight closes). HBAR #16386 LONG (bb-bounce-v2-long+, meta_rsi 56.5, -0.06%, just opened) — entered in LONG 45-60, the worst bucket of the week (43T / 17W / 39.5% / -1.35), on a signal that is 7d 17T/8W/-0.58 and all-time 43.8% WR / -0.95, the worst total PnL in the whole signal book. I would not open this fresh. HYPE #16383 LONG (hl_copy_trader, meta_rsi 26.8, +0.12%, 2.4h) — signal is 7d 0W/4T/-0.21 and all-time 30% WR; price has sat boxed 76.12-76.15 for ~20 min, 0.15% under trail-arm 76.264, and its stop is only -0.30% away while 5m ATR is 0.088% (SL = ~3.4 ATR-candles) against a TP +1.69% = ~19 ATR. In a LOW-vol drift that asymmetry resolves SL-first almost every time.

Enforced checks this cycle: no trade is up 2%+ (max +0.12%) so no breakeven-stop trigger; none is up 5%+ so no trailing trigger; none is open 8h+ (oldest 2.4h) so no stale flag. Directional exposure is 3/3 long — a single BTC dump hits all three, and all three exit on the same EMA300 condition, so they are one position, not three.

Actions: (1) 🔴 [regime] Keep all three LONGs only while 1m closes hold above EMA300 (80295 @21:46); exit trigger = 3 consecutive 1m closes below EMA300 — at that point there is no trend cover left for any of them. Re-tested this cycle: condition still holds, gap narrowing 96->25 pts. (2) 🟡 [health] HYPE #16383 — if it has not closed above 76.20 by 23:22 UTC, cut it manually rather than hand it to atr_sl: pre-trail exits are 53T / 0W / -4.70 this week and its stop is inside three ATR-candles. Re-test: price 76.15 at 21:45, not progressing. (3) 🟡 [health] HBAR #16386 — least-justified position; exit if it cannot close above entry 0.077515 by 22:42 UTC (1h from open) or if BTC loses EMA300, whichever comes first. (4) 🟢 [opportunity] STX SHORT written as watchlist pick (AI_TRADER_ENABLED=False — will NOT execute); 4/6 slots still open. (5) RETRACTED — "volume feed degrading, >100 tokens or >90 min stale" (re-tested 21:47: 119/183 tokens <10 min stale, only 38 tokens >=35 min, down from 87; condition reversed, no escalation).

- regime_5m aggregate: SHORT_BIAS (long_bias 6 / short_bias 66 / neutral 52), timestamp 21:30. Flipped LONG_BIAS -> SHORT_BIAS at 21:30 after five consecutive LONG_BIAS dumps 20:15-21:15.
- regimes.BTC (15m): NEUTRAL, held NEUTRAL across the last six dumps (20:15-21:30).
- watchdog btc_15m / btc_4h: both SHORT_BIAS.
- continuum (1m, updated 21:44): price AT EMA300 (80360 vs 80295), ema300_duration 431 min, linreg_direction LEAN_BEAR, trend_quality STRONG_DOWN, wyckoff ACCUMULATION, state_score 21.7 (watchdog summary separately reads wyckoff DISTRIBUTION).
Flip-rate KPI: aggregate 17 flips/24h, BTC 15m 16 flips/24h over 96 dumps — both inside the calibrated p25-p50 band (full-log p50=19), so this is the standing high-churn state, NOT an anomaly (>=26 is p95 "unusually unstable"). Position fit: portfolio is 3/3 LONG in a SHORT_BIAS aggregate tape. The only thing that makes this the right side is BTC's 1m holding above EMA300 — if that breaks, we are long, aligned to nothing, in a STRONG_DOWN trend_quality tape.
pattern_alerts:
All figures verified from PostgreSQL this cycle (7-day window unless noted; RSI = _signal_metadata.rsi_14, never entry_rsi_14).

PATTERN 1 — pre-trail exits are a 0% win-rate bucket (n=53). Trades exiting via atr_sl_hit / hard_max_loss / hard_sl / stale_exit / cut_loser before trail armed: 53T, 0W, -4.70 USDT. Trail-family exits (profit-monster-trail / trail_sl / atr_trail_hit / rr_engine_trail_hit / trail_arm_timeout): 58T, 44W (76%), +3.41, avg +1.85%.
WINNING SIDE: trades that survive long enough to arm the trail. WHY WE AREN'T ON IT: entries taken in low-vol chop never reach +0.40% to arm — this is exactly the "trend vs chop" split. Both current pre-arm trades (HBAR, HYPE) are heading into the 0W bucket unless they move.

PATTERN 2 — LONG at mid-band RSI is the single largest loss bucket (n=43). 7d LONG by meta_rsi band: <35: 4T/3W/+0.17 | 35-45: 6T/2W/-0.26 | 45-60: 43T/17W (39.5%)/-1.35 | 60+: 18T/9W/+0.39. SHORT by band: <35 1T/1W/+0.04 | 35-45: 13T/7W/+0.19 | 45-60: 10T/2W/-0.26 | 60+: 9T/6W (67%)/+0.91.
WINNING SIDE: momentum extremes — SHORT 60+ (+0.91) and LONG 60+ / LONG <35. WHY WE AREN'T ON IT: HBAR #16386 just opened LONG at meta_rsi 56.5, dead centre of the 39.5% bucket, on a signal whose own 7d line is 17T/-0.58.

PATTERN 3 — signal families, 7d, n>=5: LOSING: pump-chain+ 14T/14.3%WR/-0.88 (worst), bb-bounce-v2-long+ 17T/47%/-0.58, ai-trader-pending 16T/25%/-0.14, ai-trader+ 5T/40%/-0.12. WINNING: pump-chain- family 9T/+0.31, bb-squeeze+ 5T/+0.30, volume-buildup- 14T/57%/+0.20, continuum-trend+ 5T/80%/+0.09.
WINNING SIDE: the SHORT/continuation and squeeze families. WHY WE AREN'T ON IT: two of three open trades are on the two worst long families in the book (bb-bounce-v2-long+, hl_copy_trader 7d 0W/4T/-0.21, all-time 30% WR).

PATTERN 4 — direction, 7d: LONG 84T/34W (40.5%)/-1.33 vs SHORT 40T/18W (45%)/+0.74. Last 24h: 11T/9W/+1.06, shorts 6W/8T, only two losers (CHIP SHORT RSI 63.0 trail giveback, BTC SHORT manual SL).
WINNING SIDE this week: SHORT. We are 100% long. The counter-argument that keeps BTC #16385 valid: 24h LONG is 3W/3T and LONG meta_rsi<35 is positive — the losing long is the mid-band long, not every long.
